name: apex
description: APEX guard hooks for Claude Code and Codex: a secret deny that blocks Kubernetes Secret reads through kubectl, helm and the EKS MCP Server (exec, cp, attach and debug into a pod are the mutation guard's), and a mutation guard that asks before (operator) or blocks (advisor) cloud and cluster writes. The hooks are not in this release yet; they come with the class sync. Once the plugin is enabled, each hook runs; a saved false for its option in /config turns it off. On Codex no CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_* reaches the scripts, so a hook runs once trusted in Codex's /hooks, unless disabled there, and ask mode blocks. Each hook backs a rule the APEX skills already state.

apex_no_secrets.title: Secret deny (apex.no-secrets)
apex_no_secrets.description: Block Kubernetes Secret reads through kubectl, helm and the EKS MCP Server

operator_confirm_before_change.title: Mutation guard, ask (operator.confirm-before-change)
operator_confirm_before_change.description: Ask before a cloud or cluster write

advisor_no_side_effects.title: Mutation guard, block (advisor.no-side-effects)
advisor_no_side_effects.description: Block every cloud or cluster write
